enemies: Able to survive being attacked by multiple level 33 Black Knights

st.t: Speak to Sir Amik Varze on the 2nd floor of Falador Castle.
s: I laugh in the face of danger!

st.t: Put on the iron chainbody and bronze med helm. Enter the Black Knights' Fortress, north of Ice Mountain, through the sturdy door on its south side. Be prepared for multiple level 33 Black Knights to attack you.
Walk straight ahead from the door and push the wall in front of you to enter a secret room.
Climb up the ladder.
Climb up the next ladder.
Climb down the ladder south of you.
Climb up the ladder east of you.
Climb down the next ladder east of you.
Climb down the ladder west of you.
Listen at the grill.
Climb back up the ladder from the listening room.
Climb up the ladder in the chapel room east of you.
Climb down the ladder west of you.
Climb up the ladder west of you.
Climb down the ladder north of you.
Climb down the next ladder.
Push the wall to leave the secret room.
Go through the east door into the dining room. Finish the guard's dialogue and choose option 2.
s: I don't care. I'm going in anyway.

st.t: Climb the ladder at the north end of the dining room.
Push the wall to the south-east to enter the storage room
USE the cabbage on the hole. Be careful not to eat it.
Return to Sir Amik Varze in Falador Castle to complete the quest.
